title: Invariant along a finite simulation
statement: Let a register program, its initial label, an oracle, a decider machine, and a starting-state assignment be fixed, together with natural numbers $B,W$ and configurations $c,c'$ on the same Boolean input. If the program reaches $c'$ from $c$ in finitely many steps and, at every step before the endpoint, no oracle-call state is active and every register head position lies between $-1$ and $W$, then there is a finite run length realizing this same endpoint such that the invariant holds at every configuration before the endpoint.
hypotheses_covered: There is a finite simulation from $c$ to $c'$
At each simulation step before the endpoint, no call state is active
At each such step, every register head position is between $-1$ and $W$
